prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: native RGBA cutout texture atlas for low-cost distant game vegetation.
Create ONE wide transparent canvas containing eight different natural Mediterranean scrub clumps in an exact four-column by two-row regular grid. Each clump stays within its own grid cell with generous transparent margins on all sides. No plants touch between cells.
Subjects: low spreading wild rosemary, sage, maquis, olive scrub and dry grasses growing together in irregular little groups. Fine grey-green leaves, branching twigs, thin stalks, varied organic silhouettes and occasional dry tan grass. Some clumps wide and low, others upright and airy. No ornamental clipped balls, round bushes, hedges, topiary, perfect spheres or circles.
Style: real photographic isolated plant cutouts, natural believable materials and detailed leaves, not painted, low-poly, illustrative, cartoon, plastic, artificial or miniatures. Soft neutral outdoor light, muted grey olive foliage without dark black shadows or saturated green.
Composition: full plant including base, resting at the lower portion of each cell, upright view from near eye level, roots/base slightly obscured by leaves and grass. Plenty of transparent sky/space around every silhouette. Each plant fits comfortably inside one cell, all eight separate and whole. Native true transparency throughout the background. No ground planes, rocks, soil discs, pots, labels, watermarks, text, frames, checkerboards or borders.
Request 3072 by 1536 pixels or highest available resolution.
